This blueprint follows the theory note
[`doc/theory/exact-front.md`](https://github.com/aquemy/ZenoSolver/blob/master/doc/theory/exact-front.md),
which closes the gaps in the optimality arguments of Quemy & Schoenauer (EvoCOP 2015) and of
Quemy, Schoenauer & Dréo (arXiv:2304.14659, 2023). For each node it gives, where they exist, the
papers' statement, the note's statement and proof, and the Lean declarations of `lean/ZenoFront`,
with their source.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Authorship.** The grey boxes reproduce the papers verbatim, with their attribution, for
scholarly comparison. The note, the Lean development and this page are the work of Alexandre
Quemy. The statements and proofs in the blue boxes are cut out of the note when the site is built,
and the listings out of the Lean sources, so neither can drift from the repository.
:::

How to read the boxes:

::: {.from-paper}
**From the original paper.** The papers' statements, verbatim, with section and page.
:::

::: {.our-work}
**The note and Lean.** The note's statement, its proof (collapsed), the remarks around it, and the
Lean declarations that formalise it, with a link to the exact source lines.
:::

::: {.strengthen}
**What the note corrects.** Where the papers are wrong or incomplete, and what replaces them.
:::

Every node has two badges. **Lean**: [machine-checked]{.badge .ok} when every declaration that
formalises the whole statement is a theorem whose axioms are among `propext`, `Classical.choice`
and `Quot.sound` (read from `collectAxioms`, the check behind `#print axioms`, when the page is
built); [Lean definition]{.badge .ok} for definitions; [informal]{.badge .informal} when the
statement is not in Lean, possibly with formalised parts listed under it. A node is never badged
above what its own declarations cover. **Note**: [proof in the note]{.badge .informal} for a
complete written proof, [sketch]{.badge .informal}, [open problem]{.badge .open},
[refuted]{.badge .refuted} or [definition]{.badge .informal}, from the status table of §0 of the
note.
